dishes.name: Rouen duck
dishes.desc: Duckling roasted rare and served in a sauce of Bordeaux wine, shallots and the bird's own blood. It is Rouen's signature dish and is traditionally carved and finished at the table.

dishes.name: Sucre de pomme
dishes.desc: Orange apple-sugar sticks made from apple juice, apple purée and sugar, a Rouen confectionery speciality. Sold by local confectioners as a sweet to take home.

dishes.name: Douillon d'Elbeuf
dishes.desc: A whole apple, hollowed and filled with butter and sugar, wrapped in puff pastry and baked. A Seine valley treat from Elbeuf, eaten from September through winter.

dishes.name: Neufchâtel
dishes.desc: Heart-shaped cow's-milk cheese with a white bloomy rind, made in Seine-Maritime around Neufchâtel-en-Bray. One of Normandy's four AOP cheeses.

dishes.name: Marmite dieppoise
dishes.desc: Creamy fish stew from Dieppe on the Channel coast: monkfish, sole or turbot with mussels and prawns, cooked in cider or white wine and finished with cream.
